runtime_weight_views.interpretation: Allocation/view spans, not requested bytes. Logical sum deduplicates identical views; union additionally handles overlapping views.

logical.definition: Layer boundary: positions/hidden/residual input views alias-unioned within each tick; each tick receives a new value version. Static weights counted once across ticks; initial historical KV only. Current and subsequently generated K/V are internal produced values.
logical.omitted_external_small_tables: RoPE cached cos/sin and scheduler metadata are not enumerated from headers; their physical traffic remains included in D. Denominator is main-input accounting, not every external allocation.
logical.runtime_weight_note: Difference records padding/layout overhead; mathematical useful dense weights remain header-based. Neither allocation spans nor logical footprint is traced requested R.
